papers.title: Physiochemical and biological evaluation of SLM-manufactured Ti-10Ta-2Nb-2Zr alloy for biomedical implant applications.
papers.abstract: Titanium alloys, such as Ti-10Ta-2Nb-2Zr (TTNZ), are promising biomaterials due to their excellent biocompatibility and low Young's modulus. The TTNZ samples herein were manufactured by selective laser melting and the novel material was evaluated as a dental implant in vitro and in vivo. The microstructure, mechanical properties, electrochemical behaviour, cytotoxicity, haemocompatibility and osteogenic differentiation were systematically investigated. Based on the tensile test results, the as-printed TTNZ samples had an elongation of 20.23% ± 1.95%, an ultimate tensile strength of 646.61 ± 24.96 MPa and a Young's modulus of 23.72 ± 1.18 GPa. According to the biocompatible value, the as-printed TTNZ sample exhibited no cell cytotoxicity and it showed even better cell adhesion ability than that of the as-printed Ti-6Al-4 V and wrought Ti-6Al-4 V samples. The haemolysis percentage of the as-printed TTNZ sample was 0.629% ± 0.363%. Moreover, the as-printed TTNZ sample facilitated protein adsorption and osteogenic differentiation of human osteoblast-like (MG-63) cells in vitro. The in vivo data also demonstrated the histocompatibility of the as-printed TTNZ. In summary, the as-printed TTNZ developed in this study demonstrated good biocompatibility, low stress shielding, excellent ductility and great osteogenic differentiation. These results indicated that as-printed TTNZ alloys can be promising for end-use human biomedical applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造的钛合金用于牙科植入物，而非髋关节植入物，不涉及股骨应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: No hip implant biomechanics, no stress shielding quantification in femur, no micromotion analysis, and no contact mechanics modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估SLM制造的Ti-10Ta-2Nb-2Zr合金作为植入物材料的性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过选择性激光熔化制备合金，并进行体外和体内实验。
summary_zh.result: 合金具有良好的生物相容性、低弹性模量和成骨分化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内动物实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the physiochemical and biological properties of SLM-manufactured Ti-10Ta-2Nb-2Zr alloy for biomedical implant applications.
summary_en.method: The alloy was fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized by tensile tests, in vitro cell assays, and in vivo implantation.
summary_en.result: The as-printed alloy exhibited low Young's modulus, good ductility, no cytotoxicity, enhanced cell adhesion, and osteogenic differentiation.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through in vitro cytotoxicity, hemocompatibility, osteogenic differentiation assays, and in vivo histocompatibility evaluation.

papers.title: Long-term follow-up of bone remodelling after cementless hip arthroplasty using different stems.
papers.abstract: The present paper is concerned with the investigation of the phenomenon of long-term bone remodelling on cementless hip replacements. Changes in bone density in the periprosthetic region around the stem, measured by dual X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), were used as a measure of the osseous adaptation reaction. A postoperative follow-up of the use of four different types of prostheses of varying design after on average 13.3 (11.4-14.5) years. Specifically, the prostheses assessed in this study were the CLS/Spotorno stem with the Allofit cup by Zimmer, the Vision 2000 stem with the Duraloc cup by DePuy Synthes, the AlphaFit stem with the AlphaLock cup by Corin and the Mayo stem with the Trilogy cup by Zimmer. For the DXA measurement, the femur was divided into the zones suggested by Gruen et al. On the femur, there was a significant reduction in bone mineral density (BMD) in the proximal Region Of Interest (ROI) 1 (p = 0.003) and 7 (p < 0.001), whilst there was a significant increase in ROI 4 (p = 0.03). A greater degree of bone atrophy was seen in patients aged 60 years and older and in female patients. A remarkable finding when comparing the stems was a significantly greater reduction in BMD in ROI 6 (p = 0.003) in the case of the Vision 2000 stem and a markedly, but not statistically significantly smaller reduction in BMD in ROI 7 (p = 0.18) in the case of the short-stem Mayo-type prosthesis. The best clinical results were found with the use of the latter. The investigations provide a starting point for establishing a differential indication in the choice of prosthesis types, depending on age and sex, the use of short-stem prostheses, as well as the administration of bone-effective drugs for the prevention of stress shielding.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文通过DXA测量评价不同设计股骨柄的长期骨重塑，虽不直接量化应力遮挡，但为验证应力遮挡假说提供了临床依据。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not perform FE simulation, quantify stress/strain or micromotion, nor provide usable boundary conditions for implant mechanics analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究无骨水泥髋关节置换术后不同柄设计的长期骨重塑现象
summary_zh.method: 通过DXA测量平均13.3年随访中四种股骨柄假体周围Gruen分区的骨密度变化
summary_zh.result: 近端ROI 1和7骨密度显著下降，ROI 4显著上升，短柄Mayo假体在ROI 7骨密度下降较小
summary_zh.validation: 临床DXA测量，统计比较不同柄型和患者因素的BMD差异

summary_en.motivation: To investigate long-term bone remodelling after cementless hip replacement using different stem designs.
summary_en.method: Bone mineral density (BMD) changes in periprosthetic Gruen zones were measured by dual X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) at an average of 13.3 years follow-up for four stem types.
summary_en.result: Significant BMD reduction occurred in proximal zones 1 and 7, increase in zone 4; the short-stem Mayo prosthesis showed less proximal bone loss.
summary_en.validation: Clinical DXA measurements with statistical comparisons across stem types and patient demographics.
